handoff_ended.name: handoff_ended
handoff_ended.value: ("handoff"."status" = 'ended') = ("handoff"."ended_at" is not null and "handoff"."end_cause" is not null)

policies_min_max.name: policies_min_max
policies_min_max.value: "policies"."min_advance_minutes" is null or "policies"."max_advance_minutes" is null or "policies"."min_advance_minutes" <= "policies"."max_advance_minutes"

usage_settings_cap.name: usage_settings_cap
usage_settings_cap.value: not "usage_settings"."cap_enabled" or ("usage_settings"."monthly_cap_cents" is not null and "usage_settings"."monthly_cap_cents" > 0)
